description:
Outcome: Coordinator assigns plots fairly and queues unallocated applicants, from brief.md First version must 2 and Rules
Scope: Transactional explicit assignments, eligibility ordering, prevent bypassing eligible returning priority group until processed, application decisions/status, move unallocated applications to FIFO by original timestamp/stable ID, offer vacancies to earliest queued applicant, retry-safe operations. Excludes: automatic optimization, payments and plot map
Acceptance: At most one plot per household/season and holder per plot/season; previous-season holders applying strictly before 1 February garden-local time prioritized; late returners ordinary priority; waiting list independent of returner status and strictly chronological; no double allocations on retries/races
Behaviour: Stale-state conflict with reload; empty/no-capacity states; transaction rollback on failure
Verification: Table-driven cutoff/timezone/priority/FIFO cases and database concurrency tests. Prerequisites: T-005. Assumptions: T-004-reviewed interpretations; preferences advisory, coordinator chooses assignments
title: Allocation priority and FIFO waiting-list engine
